ready1_open_rewrite.title: Dataset Open Question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: In the figure, M1 and M2 are respectively the places of origin of two different raw materials, and N is the market. Read the figure and answer the question. <image1> The two raw materials necessary for a certain enterprise's production come respectively from M1 and M2, and N is this enterprise's only market; the concentric circles centered on M1 and M2 respectively represent the equal-freight lines of the two raw materials needed to produce a unit product, and the concentric circles centered on N represent the equal-freight lines of a unit product. If only the freight factor is considered, at which location in the figure is it most suitable for this enterprise to build a factory?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there are three groups of concentric circles, with centers respectively at M1 on the left side, M2 in the upper right, and N below; the candidate factory-building locations are labeled Jia, Yi, Bing, Ding, and Wu. Then reason: When only freight is considered, the three items of freight from a certain location to M1 for raw materials, to M2 for raw materials, and to the N market should be added, and the location with the smallest total freight should be chosen. Comparing the total freight, the sum of the three items at Bing is the smallest, so the most suitable factory-building location is Bing.
